设计意图： Replace earnings yield with book yield to target the weak IC. Book value is less volatile than earnings, which may improve the linear correlation while preserving the rank ordering of the original cheapness-and-solvency concept. The solvency penalty remains to avoid distressed value traps. Cross-sectional rank transform is retained because relative cheapness across stocks is economically meaningfu

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

(1/pb_lf) * (1 - debttoassets/100)
依赖列: pb_lf, debttoassets

📚 字段与算子释义

输入字段

字段含义说明
pb_lfPB 市净率 (last_filed)最新披露市净率 = price / 每股净资产
debttoassets资产负债率总负债 / 总资产

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

(1/pb_lf) * (1 - debttoassets/100)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：divide(1, pb_lf) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  2. 步骤2：divide(debttoassets, 100) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  3. 步骤3：subtract(1, v2(divide)) → 减法：x - y
  4. 步骤4：multiply(v1(divide), v3(subtract)) → 乘法：x × y

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
debttoassets资产负债率（杠杆字段）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 book_yield：1.0 / pb_lf
  2. 计算 solvency：(1.0 - debttoassets.abs() / 100.0).clip(lower=0)
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_book_yield_solvency(df): df_copy = df.copy() book_yield = 1.0 / df_copy["pb_lf"].replace(0, np.nan) solvency = (1.0 - df_copy["debttoassets"].abs() / 100.0).clip(lower=0) df_copy["factor_book_yield_solvency"] = book_yield * solvency "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_book_yield_solvency"]
